The acknowledgment from two of the sport’s biggest names signals a shift in the betting market: the “Winner” odds for Hamilton and Russell may widen, while Antonelli’s markets become more attractive.
A former commentator’s dismissive comment about Antonelli’s “luck” highlights the debate over his recent form.
Despite the criticism, Antonelli’s performance has been consistent enough to earn him a spot in the top‑tier markets.
The FIA President’s confirmation that Fernando Alonso will remain in the championship is a relief for his loyal fan base.
While Alonso’s car, the Alpine A513, may not be a title contender, he is still a credible threat for “Podium” markets on circuits that suit his overtaking prowess.
